summary: Researched Coinbase as one immutable digital-finance platform. Stablecoin adoption and positive operating cash support the rails thesis, but falling cyclical revenue, one-counterparty concentration, custody obligations, GAAP losses, equity compensation, and absent downside valuation block a strategy. Updated it to medium-confidence watching.

evidence.claim: Net revenue was USD 1.34 billion, stablecoin revenue USD 305 million, net loss USD 394 million, operating cash flow USD 183 million, one counterparty 23% of total revenue, and stock compensation USD 248 million.
The issuer reported rising trading-volume share, derivatives adoption, and Base agentic stablecoin activity during the quarter.

daily_report_items: Coinbase remains watching: real stablecoin-rail adoption is offset by cycle, counterparty, custody, GAAP-loss, dilution, and valuation risks.
